I’m thinking about whether it's okay to return early in a BFS when encountering the sink. So, if all nodes at the previous level have been discovered, it gives us a clear path to the sink. I’m wondering if I should still run complete BFS beyond the sink, or if it’s better to optimize on level cutoff.
